What is the mean number of times the coin lands on heads?" :question/worked-solution "Let the random variable $X$ be equal to the number of times the coin lands on heads. 

Here, we have the following information:

- there are $n=7$ tosses

- the probability of landing on heads for each toss is $p=0.4$

So, $X$ follows a binomial distribution, where $X\sim B(7,0.4).$

For a binomial random variable $X,$ the mean is given by

$$
\textrm E[X] = np,
$$

where $n$ is the number of experiments, and $p$ is the probability of success on each experiment.

So, the mean of the number of times the coin lands on heads is

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =np \\  & =(7)(0.4) \\  & =2.8.\end{aligned}
$$" :db/ensure [:question/validate]} {:db/id 17592186133846 :knowledge-point/questions ["question-afe30003-2595-50a2-8b60-8382c78a5f23" "question-ed91a13d-0a09-59c4-bf60-d5ad7aad9e5f" "question-35949c7a-955a-5bb4-ba6f-41e4641f0ce2" "question-5f3fbaf6-b15b-53c6-9279-fcc77fd83e0b"] :db/ensure [:knowledge-point/validate]} {:db/id 17592186133661 :question/worked-solution "Let the random variable $X$ be equal to the number of arrows that hit the bull's eye.

\textrm{Var}[X] = np(1-p),

 So, the variance of the number of arrows hitting the bull's eye is
